40018952.author: पदार्थः
40018952.content: रणे battlefield, निर्जितम् without life, निहतम् killed, शयानम् lying, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, शोकवेगपरीतात्मा immersed in sorrow, विललाप lamented

40018952.author: Translation
40018952.content: Vibheeshana, seeing his brother killed and lying in the battlefield, lamented immersed in sorrow.

40018953.author: पदार्थः
40018953.content: वीर valiant, विक्रान्त powerful, विख्यात renowned, प्रवीण skilled in all fields, नयकोविद in polity, महार्हशयनोपेत accustomed to sumptuous bed, निहतः killed, भुवि on ground, किम् why, शेषे lying

40018953.author: Translation
40018953.content: "O valiant, powerful and renowned king! You who were skilled in all fields and in polity, accustomed to a sumptuous bed, why are you lying on ground?"

40018954.author: पदार्थः
40018954.content: अङ्गदभूषितौ decked with armlets, निश्चेष्टौ motionless, भुजौ arms, विक्षिप्य broken, अपवृत्ने knocked down, भास्करा Sun, कारवर्चसा charming armlets, मुकुटेन with the crown

40018954.author: Translation
40018954.content: "Decked with armlets, motionless are your arms, broken, knocked down with the crown, radiant like the Sun."

40018955.author: पदार्थः
40018955.content: वीर hero, मया by me, यत् this, पूर्वम् earlier, ईरितम् predicted, यत् that which, काममोहपरीतस्य overcome by infatuation, तव your, न रुचितम् not find favour, तत् that, इदम् thus, प्राप्तम् true

40018955.author: Translation
40018955.content: "Hero! That which was predicted by me earlier, which did not find your favour due to your infatuation, has come true."

40018956.author: पदार्थः
40018956.content: यत् that which, दर्पात् out of pride, प्रहस्तोवा either Prahastha, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, अपरेजनाः other Rakshasas, न nor, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, न nor, अतिरथः exceeding car warrior, अतिकायः Athikaya, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, न nor, स्वयम् you also, त्वम् your, न अमन्येथाः not cared for, तस्य its, अयम् this, उदर्कः consequence, आगतः has come

40018956.author: Translation
40018956.content: "Either Prahastha or Indrajith or other Rakshasas, or even Kumbhakarna, an exceeding car warrior, nor Atikaya or Naranthaka or you also did not care for my counsel. Its consequence has come now."

40018957.author: पदार्थः
40018957.content: शस्त्रभृताम् wielders of weapons, वरे choicest, अस्मिन् वीरे this hero, भूमौ on ground, निपतिते fallen down, सुनीतीनाम् prudent, सेतुः boundary, गतः disappeared, धर्मस्य righteousness, विग्रहः form, गतः departed, सत्त्वस्य repository of might, सङ्क्षेपः thrown down, गतः out of sight, प्रस्तावानाम् praise worthy for all, गतिः position, गता lost, आदित्यः Sun, भूमौ on ground, पतितः fallen, चन्द्रमाः moon, तमसि darkness, मग्नः plunged, चित्रभानुः fire, प्रशान्तार्चिः extinct, व्यवसायः enthusiasm, निरुद्यमः wasted

40018957.author: Translation
40018957.content: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

40018958.author: पदार्थः
40018958.content: शस्त्रभृताम् wielders of weapons, वरे choicest, अस्मिन् वीरे this hero, भूमौ on ground, निपतिते fallen down, सुनीतीनाम् prudent, सेतुः boundary, गतः disappeared, धर्मस्य righteousness, विग्रहः form, गतः departed, सत्त्वस्य repository of might, सङ्क्षेपः thrown down, गतः out of sight, प्रस्तावानाम् praise worthy for all, गतिः position, गता lost, आदित्यः Sun, भूमौ on ground, पतितः fallen, चन्द्रमाः moon, तमसि darkness, मग्नः plunged, चित्रभानुः fire, प्रशान्तार्चिः extinct, व्यवसायः enthusiasm, निरुद्यमः wasted

40018958.author: Translation
40018958.content: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

40018959.author: पदार्थः
40018959.content: शस्त्रभृताम् wielders of weapons, वरे choicest, अस्मिन् वीरे this hero, भूमौ on ground, निपतिते fallen down, सुनीतीनाम् prudent, सेतुः boundary, गतः disappeared, धर्मस्य righteousness, विग्रहः form, गतः departed, सत्त्वस्य repository of might, सङ्क्षेपः thrown down, गतः out of sight, प्रस्तावानाम् praise worthy for all, गतिः position, गता lost, आदित्यः Sun, भूमौ on ground, पतितः fallen, चन्द्रमाः moon, तमसि darkness, मग्नः plunged, चित्रभानुः fire, प्रशान्तार्चिः extinct, व्यवसायः enthusiasm, निरुद्यमः wasted

40018959.author: Translation
40018959.content: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

40018960.author: पदार्थः
40018960.content: राक्षसशार्दूले tiger among Rakshasas, रणे in the battlefield, पांसुषु dust, प्रसुप्तेइव fallen like this asleep, सम्प्रति everything, गतसत्त्वस्य strength departed, लोकस्य in the world, इह now, किम् what, शेषम् is left

40018960.author: Translation
40018960.content: "With the tiger among the Rakshasas fallen asleep like this in the dust in the battlefield, strength of the people departed. What is left in this world?"

40018961.author: पदार्थः
40018961.content: धृतिप्रवालः firmness as leaves, प्रसह्याग्य्रपुष्प stubbornness as blossom, तपोबलः austerity, शौर्यनिबद्धमालः valour as strong roots, महान् great, राक्षसराजवृक्षः tree of Rakshasa king, राघवमारुतेन by the tempest of Raghava, रणे in the battlefield, संमर्धितः crushed

40018961.author: Translation
40018961.content: "The great tree in the form of Rakshasa king, with its firmness as leaves, stubbornness as its blossom, austerity as strength, valour as strong roots, was crushed by the tempest of Raghava in the battlefield."

40018962.author: पदार्थः
40018962.content: तेजोविषाणः prowess as tusks, कुलवंशवंशः the father and grandfather as back of the body, कोपप्रसादपरगात्रहस्तः wrath as lower body and graciousness as proboscis, रावणगन्धहस्ती, Ravana as the elephant in rut, इक्ष्वाकुसिंसावगृहीतदेहः lion in the shape of king of Ikshvaku race, क्षितौ overthrown on the ground, सुप्तः lying asleep

40018962.author: Translation
40018962.content: "Ravana's prowess as tusks, father and grand fathers' race as back of the body, wrath as lower body and graciousness as proboscis, overthrown by a lion in the shape of Ikshvaku race having killed him he is lying asleep thrown down."

40018963.author: पदार्थः
40018963.content: पराक्रमोत्साहविजृम्भितार्चिः prowess and exceeding energy as flames, निःश्वासधूमः sighs as smoke, स्वबलप्रतापः own strength as heat, सम्यति in the battlefield, प्रतापवान् endowed with prowess, राक्षसाग्नि: fire of Rakshasa, रामपयोधरेण by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama, निर्वापितः extinguished

40018963.author: Translation
40018963.content: "The prowess and exceeding energy of Ravana as flames, his sighs as smoke, his own strength as heat, endowed with might, that fire of Rakshasa has been extinguished by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama in the battlefield."

40018964.author: पदार्थः
40018964.content: सिंहर्क्षलाङ्गूलककुद्विषाणः Rakshasas as tails, humps, and horns, पराभिजित् the conqueror of its enemies, गन्धनगन्धहस्ती in pride like elephant in rut, चापकर्णचक्षुः animality as ears and eyes, रक्षोवृषः the bull in the form of Rakshasa, क्षितीश्वरव्याघ्रहतः tiger in the form of Rama master of the earth, अवसन्नः gone off

40018964.author: Translation
40018964.content: "Rakshasas who followed as tails, humps and horns, Ravana the conquerors of enemies, like elephants in pride, animality as ears and eyes, the bull in the form of Rakshasa Ravana was killed by Rama, the master of earth in the form of tiger."

40018965.author: पदार्थः
40018965.content: रामः Rama, वदन्तम् countenance, शोकसमाविष्टम् overcome by sorrow, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, हेतुमत् with reason, परिदृष्टार्थनिश्चयम् determined opinion, वाक्यम् words, इति thus, उवाच spoke

40018965.author: Translation
40018965.content: Thus spoke Rama to Vibheeshana, who was overcome with sorrow and speaking with reason, his determined opinion.

40018966.author: पदार्थः
40018966.content: अयम् this, निश्चेष्टः without power, न विनष्टः not destroyed, समरे in war, चण्डविक्रमः of terrible prowess, अयम् this, अत्युन्नतमहोत्साहः extraordinary enthusiasm, अशङ्कितः without any fear, पतितः fallen

40018966.author: Translation
40018966.content: "This Ravana is not destroyed without power in war. He is of terrible prowess, of extraordinary enthusiasm and fought without any fear and fallen."

40018967.author: पदार्थः
40018967.content: ये those who, क्षत्रधर्मव्यवस्थिताः kings who follow duty steadfast, वृधदिम् desiring advancement, अशंसमानाः fearless, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, निपतन्ति fallen, विनष्टाः lost, एवम् in that way, न शोच्यन्ते not to be mourned

40018967.author: Translation
40018967.content: "Those kings who follow duty steadfast, desiring advancement, fearless in the battlefield, who die in that way should not be mourned."

40018968.author: पदार्थः
40018968.content: धीमता wise, येन being, युधि war, सेन्द्राः Indra, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, त्रासिताः fear, तस्मिन् his, कालसमायुक्ते brought under the sway of time, परिशोचितुम् to grieve, कालः time, न not

40018968.author: Translation
40018968.content: "He who is wise, and the three worlds fear him, including Indra, the Lord of gods, when brought under the sway of death according to timespirit, should not be mourned."

40018969.author: पदार्थः
40018969.content: कदाचन not only that, युद्धे in war, एकान्तविजयः victorious alone, न भूतपूर्वः now or before, वीरः heroic, संयुगे in war, परैः enemy, हन्यतेवा will kill, परान् by enemy, हन्तिवा be killed

40018969.author: Translation
40018969.content: "Not only that, in war, he will only will be victorious is not true now or before. Hero may kill the enemy or will be killed by the enemy."

40018970.author: पदार्थः
40018970.content: इयम् this, पूर्वैः in the past, सन्दिष्टा in battle, क्षत्रियसम्मता acceptable for ancient kings, गतिः course, सङ्ख्ये action, निहतः killed, क्षत्रियः king, न शोच्यः not mourned, इति this, निश्चयः is true

40018970.author: Translation
40018970.content: "This course has been practised in the past by ancient kings for those killed in war. Warrior killed in war is not to be mourned', is true."

40018971.author: पदार्थः
40018971.content: तत् that, एवम् in that way, निश्चयम् determined, दृष्टवा seeing, तत्त्वम् in principle, आस्थाय considering, विज्वरः freed from grief, इह here, अनन्तरम् later, यत् that which, कार्यम् action, कल्प्यम् to be done, तत् that, अनुचिन्तय is required

40018971.author: Translation
40018971.content: In principle, in that way, decide the action, freed from grief, considering what action is required."

40018972.author: पदार्थः
40018972.content: उक्तवाक्यम् having spoken like that, विक्रान्तम् valiant, तंराजपुत्रम् prince, शोकसन्तप्तः immersed in grief, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अनन्तरम् after that, भ्रातुः brother, हितम् good, उवाच spoke

40018972.author: Translation
40018972.content: Having spoken that way by the valiant prince to Vibheeshana, who was immersed in grief, spoke to Rama for the good of his brother.

40018973.author: पदार्थः
40018973.content: यः he who, अयम् this, विमर्देषु in battle, स्समस्थेरपि combined together in trial of strength, सुरैरपि even gods, वासवेन by Indra, भग्नपूर्वः not defeated, भवन्तम् by you, आसाद्य routed, वेलाम् flow, आसाद्य routed, समुद्रःयथा like the ocean, रणे in war, विभग्नः divides

40018973.author: Translation
40018973.content: "He who has not been defeated in battle by even gods or Indra combined together in a trial of strength has been routed by you like the flow of the ocean divides on reaching the shore."

40018974.author: पदार्थः
40018974.content: अनेन many, वनीपकेषु mendicants, दत्तानि bestowed, भोगाश्च gifts, भुक्ताः nurtured, भृत्याः dependants निभृताः filled with, धनानि wealth, मित्रेषु to friends, समर्पितानि given, वैराणि grudges, अमित्रेषु to enemies, निपातितानि destroyed

40018974.author: Translation
40018974.content: "He bestowed gifts to mendicants, nurtured dependents, filled his friends with wealth, and held grudges against enemies and destroyed them."

40018975.author: पदार्थः
40018975.content: एषः he, हिताग्नि: maintained sacred fire, महातपाश्च practised austerities, वेदान्तगः mastered vedas, कर्मसु च even in doing rituals, अग्रशूरः foremost, प्रेतगतस्य departed soul, एतस्य to him, कृत्यम् to do the rituals, तव your, प्रसादात् permission, कर्तुम् will do, इच्छामि I desire

40018975.author: Translation
40018975.content: "He maintained sacrificial fire and practised austerities. He mastered vedas and was even doing rituals. To the foremost brother's departed soul, I desire your permission to do the rituals."
